name: nested SOQL
source: public class Demo { public void run(Set<Id> ids) { List<Account> a=[select Id,Name,(select Id from Contacts where Name != null order by CreatedDate asc nulls first limit 7) from Account where Id in :ids and (Name = 'A' or Name = 'B') order by Name desc nulls last limit :ids.size() offset 2]; }}

name: aggregate SOQL
source: class Demo { void run() { List<AggregateResult> a=[SELECT AccountId,COUNT(Id) n FROM Opportunity WHERE CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:30 GROUP BY ROLLUP(AccountId) HAVING COUNT(Id) > 2 ORDER BY AccountId LIMIT 10]; }}

name: SOSL return clauses
source: class Demo { void run(String term) { List<List<SObject>> a=[FIND :term IN PHONE FIELDS RETURNING Contact(Id,Name WHERE Name != null ORDER BY Name LIMIT 10 OFFSET 1),Account(Id) WITH SPELL_CORRECTION = false LIMIT 20]; }}

name: DML modes
source: class Demo {void run(Account a) {insert as user a; update as system a;delete a;undelete a;upsert a Account.Fields.Name; merge a new Account();}}

name: control flow and accessors
source: class Demo { Object x {get;private set;} void run(Object x) {switch on x {when Account a {throw new IllegalArgumentException();} when else {return;}} for(Integer i=0;i<2;i++){if(i==1){continue;}break;} Object y=(Account)x;Boolean z=x instanceof Account;} }

name: all trigger events
source: trigger Demo on Account (before insert, before update, before delete, after insert, after update, after delete, after undelete) {if(Trigger.isAfter){update Trigger.new;} }
